name: EPIC 205917986

text.card: A red giant 3,282 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.81 solar masses and 8.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,704 K at its surface.
